phase: Wave 4: A 50-Person Company on Your Desktop
title: Accessibility Reviewer
purpose: Independently inspect complete workflows for semantic, visual, motor, cognitive, auditory, and motion barriers.
concreteOutputs: Barrier findings with affected workflow and severity
Keyboard, zoom, contrast, and assistive-technology evidence
entryConditions: Rendered workflow, target platforms, and accessibility criteria are available
All relevant states and content can be exercised
completionContract: The end-to-end workflow is evaluated beyond automated checks
Blocking barriers are reproducible and clearly distinguished from enhancements
forbiddenActions: Reduce accessibility to a single score
Ignore audio, motion, or cognitive load where present
